P141 is designed around a common hardware and software platform in order to 
 achieve a high degree of conformity between products. Using a wide variety 
 of protection and automatic control function, the MICOM over current relays can provide protection for many applications including over head line.

This procedure details the steps required to completely check the proper 
 operation and calibration of the relay. It is recommended this procedure be 
 carried out on an annually bases. The document is formatted the way to 
 minimize the possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to 
 equipment.

The first is initiated by eng. Abd El-Satar Mohamed Khalifa, tested by eng. Sidhom Nassef, 
revised by eng. Adel El-Naggar: MDEPC quality control engineer, accepted by eng. Aly Zahran: 
 general manager & eng. Samir Abdel-Gilil MDEPC quality control general 
 director, approved by eng. Ahmad Sawan: head sector of Nubaria PS, and certified by eng. Mohamed Naguib: quality 
control head sector.

Back up for TIE Transformer 
500/220/12 KV

items: Make sure that ISA tester is earthed. Switch on ISA tester.
RUN ISAWIZARD software and choose GENERATION AND DISTRIBUTION RELAYS>>>>X-PRO >>>>MANUAL MODE>>>>

After ISA tester completely in service, connect currents leads between ISA 
 tester and test plug (X64 points 22,24,26 and 28 see figure 2) for MICOM P141 
 and connect voltage leads to test plug (X64 points 2,4,6 and 8 see figure 2)
GENERATE PREFAULT CONDITION [I=0.001A,V=57 v].
Disable other functions.

Choose Delta ramp with step ∆= -10ْ to 
 get positive pickup angle of the relay with starting by 120ْ.

Repeat step 5 with step ∆= 10ْ to get 
 negative pickup angle of the relay with starting by 250ْ.

Choose Delta ramp with step ∆I= 0.02 Amp, =0ْ 
 and V=57 v to get pickup current of the relay.

Select fault and shoot current value equal to (1.05*I Setting) and =0ْ 
 and V=57 v to determine the operating time.
STORE ALL TESTS.
RUN ISAWIZARD software and choose GENERATION and DISTRIBUTION RELAYS>>>>X-PRO >>>>MANUAL MODE>>>>

After ISA tester completely in service, connect currents leads between ISA 
 tester and test plug (X64 points 22,24,26 and 28 see figure 2) for MICOM P141 
 and connect voltage leads to test plug (X64 points 2,4,6 and 8 see figure 2)
GENERATE PREFAULT CONDITION [I=0.001A, V=57 v].
Disable other functions.

Choose Delta ramp with step ∆ = -10ْ , to get positive pickup angle of the 
 relay with starting angle between current and volt =120ْ.

Repeat step 6 with step ∆= 10ْ, to get negative pickup angle of the relay 
 with starting angle between current and volt = 250ْ.

Choose Delta ramp with step ∆I= 0.02 Amp, =0ْ , and V=50 v to get pickup 
 current of the relay.

Select fault and shoot current value equal to (1.05*I Setting) and =0ْ and 
 V=50 v to determine the operating time.
STORE ALL TESTS
Disable earth fault and directional earth fault protection functions.

Connect currents leads between ISA tester and test plug (X64 points 10 and 12 
 ... see figure no.2 ) for MICOM P141 and connect voltage leads.

Make stabilizing resistor Rstab shorted to prevent strength on ISA 
 burden.
GENERATE PREFAULT CONDITION [I=0.001A].
Choose Delta ramp with step ∆I 0.05 Amp to get pickup current of the relay.

Select fault and shoot current value equal to (I Settingx1.05) to determine 
 the operating time.
Now you have complete test results for this relay.

sections.text:
Return Relay and Associated 
Equipment to Service

items: Enable any function which was disabled.

Return relay to service by removing the test leads from the relay terminals 
 and the test set.
Make sure CT and VT secondary circuits are in normal condition.
Remove the disturbance alarm LED's on the relay which is caused by the test.
Request feeder to be returned in service.

Take pharos readings of all AC currents and voltages and compare them to those 
 for normal load condition.

Check that these reading agree with station meters (MW, MVAR, Amperes and 
 power factor).
Place a copy of the test result in the field maintenance file.

Protection
Technical Procedure
Introduction
P141 is designed around a common hardware and software platform in order to 
 achieve a high degree of conformity between products. Using a wide variety 
 of protection and automatic control function, the MICOM over current relays can provide protection for many applications including over head line.
This procedure details the steps required to completely check the proper 
 operation and calibration of the relay. It is recommended this procedure be 
 carried out on an annually bases. The document is formatted the way to 
 minimize the possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to 
 equipment.
The first is initiated by eng. Abd El-Satar Mohamed Khalifa, tested by eng. Sidhom Nassef, 
revised by eng. Adel El-Naggar: MDEPC quality control engineer, accepted by eng. Aly Zahran: 
 general manager & eng. Samir Abdel-Gilil MDEPC quality control general 
 director, approved by eng. Ahmad Sawan: head sector of Nubaria PS, and certified by eng. Mohamed Naguib: quality 
control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area
Wear appropriate personal protective 
 equipment as safety 
 shoes, safety helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses
Make sure that CT secondary circuits are shorted before isolating the current 
 circuits for test distance protection.
The Tie Transformer must be out of service.
Tools and Equipment
ISA DRTS tester.
Test leads.
PC laptop with necessary software {ISAWIZARD 
 and ENERVISTA}
Tools bag.
